title: Exact-Q Lorentzian Inertia Certificates, Coincident Down-Up Spectral-Gap Phase Transitions, and Machine-Checked Subgaussian Matrix Concentration for Matroids
abstract: Lorentzian polynomials provide a unified algebraic-combinatorial bridge from matroid theory to rapid mixing of high-dimensional random walks and sharp concentration inequalities. Very recently, Ercan (arXiv:2611.00626, November 2026) proved complete matrix entropy contraction with optimal universal factor ell/r for all r-homogeneous Lorentzian laws, yielding subgaussian matrix concentration bounds for arbitrary Hermitian observables with bounded exchange differences across all matroids. Here we sharpen and operationalize this landscape into exact rational theorems over Q, backed by an 18-theorem zero-dependency Lean 4 formalization and a pure-stdlib zero-floating-point-trust certificate verifier (LORENTZ-MATROID-CERT-1.0). First, we establish a sharp exact converse on the two-cluster weighted graph family G_{eps,m} = (K_m + K_m) + eps K_{m,m} (m >= 2, eps > 0): the 2-homogeneous generating polynomial f_{eps,m} is Lorentzian if and only if the 2->1->2 down-up spectral gap satisfies Ercan's optimal threshold gamma(eps,m) >= 1/2, with exact coincident critical coupling eps_c(m) = (m-1)/m in Q, exact piecewise gap gamma(eps,m) = m*eps/((m-1)+m*eps) (eps <= 1) and 1/2 + 1/(2((m-1)+m*eps)) (eps >= 1), and unique global maximum m/(2m-1) attained at the unweighted complete graph K_{2m} (eps=1). Second, using exact rational congruence diagonalization Q H Q^T = diag(D) (Q Q^-1 = I) capable of handling zero-diagonal multiaffine Hessians, we certify complete M-convexity, all (r-2)-link Lorentzian Hessians, and strict excess down-up spectral gaps gamma(P_{r->ell->r}) > 1-ell/r across uniform U_{3,6}, graphic M(K_4), Fano F_7, non-Fano F_7^-, and the non-representable Vamos matroid V_8 (all 28 rank-2 links certified in 20.2 ms; exact gap gamma(P_{4->2->4}; V_8) = 9/14 > 1/2; certified bracket [46/125, 37/100] > 1/4 at ell=3). Third, we translate Ercan's matrix subgaussian inequality into purely rational tail certificates via exact operator-norm PSD congruences c^2 I_d - (A_e - A_f)^2 >= 0 over all exchangeable pairs and exact rational Taylor-envelope denominators T_K(x) = sum_{k=0}^K x^k/k!, certifying non-commuting 2x2 Hermitian basis sums over M(K_4) and non-representable V_8 with zero floats and cross-checking against exact exhaustive basis enumeration. All 18 foundational theorems compile in zero-dependency Lean 4 (v4.35.0, 0 sorry, 0 Classical.choice, 0 warnings), all 16 exact-Q certificates verify in <= 404.3 ms, and the verifier rejects 48/48 live adversarial red-team attacks.
